data.name: Khadra
data.gender_notes: Khadra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'khadra' meaning 'green'. In Islamic tradition, it is said that the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) favorite wife, Aisha (ra), was called Khadija bint Khalid, meaning 'the one with the beautiful green eyes'. The name Khadra carries the meaning “Evergreen” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khadra usually hope their child will grow to embody evergreen and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Khadra is a name that is deeply rooted in Islamic spirituality. It is a name that is mentioned in the Quran and hadiths. According to Islamic tradition, Khadra is the name of a tree that is mentioned in the Quran. It is also the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who was known for her wisdom, beauty, and piety. Khadra is a name that is often used as a reminder of the beauty and majesty of nature, and the importance of nurturing and protecting the natural world.
data.etymology: Khadra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Evergreen.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khadra total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
